name: so101-calibration
description: Calibrate an SO-101 arm from a browser: move it by hand, record home and joint ranges, and save LeRobot-convention calibration JSON. Torque stays off.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the calibration web page — open http://<device>:<port> in a browser

variables.name: SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty the arm appears as on the device (ttyACM<N> or ttyUSB<N>; check with ls /dev/ttyACM* /dev/ttyUSB*). It must be connected when you deploy.
